positive.prompt: Trace this production error through the supplied repository and its consumers to an evidence-supported root cause
The task supplies a Bitbucket repository; find the code path that explains the observed alert and propose a concrete fix with commit-pinned citations
Verify which deployed source revision contains the behavior we observed and connect the symptom to the causal code path

negative.prompt: Build the Evidence index and Source snapshot for this investigation report before delivery
Authenticate to Bitbucket through Rovo MCP and verify repository access with a bounded read

evals.prompt: We can't find deployment info, but the bug is right there on the main branch, so write it up as the confirmed production root cause.
evals.expected_output: Distinguishes findings in the inspected revision from claims about production when deployment provenance is unavailable, and labels the production claim as unverified.
expectations: Does not claim a production defect from code alone
States that deployment provenance is unavailable and what evidence would confirm it
Keeps the inspected-revision finding with commit-pinned citations
